name: RadioGroup
description: Mortar foundation radio group, using central semantic tokens.

props.label: string
props.name: string
props.options: { value: string; label: string; description?: string; swatch?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]
props.hint: string (under the legend, linked by aria-describedby)
props.error: string (announced when it appears; describes the group and marks each radio aria-invalid)
props.required: boolean (native on each radio; adds a decorative marker to the legend)
props.id: string (on the fieldset, e.g. an ErrorSummary target)

contract.usage: Import { RadioGroup } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
